answer: At dawn, a beacon spot-checks 5% of identities: each must solve a fresh puzzle in 60 seconds, proving a distinct machine. The window is a karst passage: 1,000 clones behind one server cannot all pass. A missed heartbeat or matching signatures suspend the identity and burn 60 coins. 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 coins plus 1,000 machines, against a 30,000-coin pool. Honest agents pay 60 coins once and keep their full share, blooming like a lotus.
